text.p: JMAR Industries Inc Wednesday signed a letter of intent to acquire Santa Fe Laser Co, a privately held Tucson, Ariz.-based manufacturer of diode-pumped solid state laser products.
The purchase price, payable in shares of JMAR stock, will be based on Santa Fe's pretax earnings from the date of closing through Dec. 31, 1998, the company said in a statement.
The closing of the transaction, scheduled for Sept. 30, is subject to several conditions, including the satisfactory completion of due diligence by both parties.

For its fiscal year ended Jan. 31, Santa Fe reported sales in excess of $1 million. Excluding the potential of emerging JMAR products, Santa Fe expects sales to exceed $2 million this fiscal year and more than double next year.
